<ic>To commission the enlargement of the Imperial Marcher army the Drakes.<br>''Proposed by Mitwold, seconded by Mournwold.''</ic>
==Overview==
* To enlarge the Drakes army, in line with the [[opportunity]] presented by the [[Bills_or_bows#The_Drakes|recent proposal]].
* Passed at 0 Thrones

==Date==
* Winter 382YE
==Cost==

* 125 wains mithril or weirwood
* No money is required
* nine months to complete

{{CommissionProgress|Enlarge_Drakes}}
